title: Incomprehensible
summary: INCOMPREHENS'IBLE, adjective 1. That cannot be comprehended or understood; That is beyond the reach of human intellect; inconceivable. The nature of spiritual being is incomprehensible to us, or by us

inlines.v: INCOMPREHENS'IBLE, adjective 1. That cannot be comprehended or understood; That is beyond the reach of human intellect; inconceivable. The nature of spiritual being is incomprehensible to us, or by us. 2. Not to be contained. [Little used.]
